aws-lc-rs 1.11.1.why: build.rs only re-exports the DEP_AWS_LC_* variables of aws-lc-sys to dependents; nothing the crate itself compiles reads them.

aws-lc-sys 0.23.1.why: build.rs compiles the bundled AWS-LC with CMake and emits cfg x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu (selects the pre-generated bindings). Replaced by komira//third_party/aws-lc:crypto, linked into each executable (native_deps). That AWS-LC is the same release (1.39.0) but its symbols are komira_awslc_X, where the bindings say aws_lc_0_23_1_X, so the bindings are rewritten; the three ERR_GET_*_RUST C wrappers (rust_wrapper.c) become Rust.

aws-types 1.3.10.why: build.rs writes build_env.rs, const RUST_VERSION = the rustc version. The pinned rustc is 1.85.0.

getrandom 0.3.4.why: emits cfgs only for msan and windows; none on linux.

httparse 1.10.1.why: rustc >= 1.59 and std: SIMD cfgs. No sse4.2/avx2 target feature at baseline x86-64, so runtime detection only.

icu_normalizer_data 2.1.1.why: emits a cfg only when ICU4X_DATA_DIR is set.

icu_properties_data 2.1.2.why: emits a cfg only when ICU4X_DATA_DIR is set.

libc 0.2.190.why: x86_64 linux gnu: linux_time_bits64 (target_os linux, 64-bit pointers).

proc-macro2 1.0.107.why: stable rustc, no span-locations: wrap_proc_macro. The unstable probes fail on stable.

rustversion 1.0.23.why: build/build.rs asks rustc --version and writes version.expr, a struct literal that src/lib.rs includes. Written for 1.85.0 stable.

serde 1.0.229.why: build.rs writes private.rs (a module named for the patch version) and emits if_docsrs_then_no_serde_core; all minor-version cfgs are off at 1.85. The file is placed beside each include! (lib.rs and core/crate_root.rs).

serde_core 1.0.229.why: build.rs writes private.rs (module named for the patch version); every no_* cfg is off at rustc 1.85.

zerocopy 0.8.63.why: the cfgs for features newer than the pinned rustc, from [package.metadata.build-rs] in Cargo.toml: those above 1.85 are 1.87 and 1.89.
